finalText:
Good news, it's a small cleanup: 17 call sites still pass the legacy rounding flag.

`src\reports\quarterly.js` has the most, with 5.

The rest are spread thin: `billing\invoice.js` and `admin\exports.js` have 3 each, `reports\monthly.js` and `checkout\cart.js` have 2 each, and `checkout\receipt.js` and `billing\statement.js` have 1 each. All 17 pass `true` as the second argument.
